caption: The drawing features a single, transparent glass object centered on a blank, beige background. The glass object consists of a round, bulbous bowl at the top with a short, narrow neck, sitting on a slender stem composed of several stacked, rounded sections of varying thickness. The stem is attached to a wide, flat circular base. The object is rendered in grayscale, with subtle shading and highlights that indicate its reflective, transparent surface and curved forms. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the composition. The drawing is signed "chas. Chesu" in small letters in the lower left corner.
